population: all 1000 existing primary native traces, query IDs 0..999; full native path, forced-native/off-policy learned scores after divergence
short_blocks: count separately; no replacement and excluded from the prespecified Top1-versus-31 primary statistic
anchor: first lane attaining the minimum exact FP32 reference distance over the complete 32-lane block, before pending filtering
pair_eligibility: anchor and competitor are distinct targets, both unexpanded after the source-center expansion; exact distance competitor-anchor > 1e-7
true_ties: count separately; excluded from error-rate denominators
continuous_preference: anchor score strictly less than competitor score; approximate score equality conservatively counts as an error
bucket_preference: lexicographic ascending (actual bucket ID, negative proposal arrival serial); same bucket uses LIFO
proposal_arrival: increment for every lane, including visited targets, as in validated replay; compare local proposal tokens, not global queue winners
query_weighting: equal weight over queries with at least one eligible pair; report queries with no eligible pair without filling their undefined ratios with zero
E_numerator: mean_query[(continuous native-wrong learned-correct AND unchanged local bucket preference)/n_pairs]
E: E_numerator/E_denominator; not mean_query[unchanged/corrections]; additionally report raw unchanged and correction counts
zero_E_denominator: E is null and mechanism gate is insufficient

bootstrap.unit: query, preserving every within-query comparison and using one shared index draw across metrics
bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive query-cluster stability on repeatedly used queries, not an independent population guarantee

support_gate: delta_cont<=-0.01 AND delta_bucket>=0 AND E>=0.75 AND CI97.5(I_B).lower>0, with all minimum counts satisfied
refutation_gate: E<=0.25 AND delta_bucket<=-0.01 AND CI97.5(delta_bucket).upper<0, with all minimum counts satisfied
otherwise: inconclusive, or insufficient if minimum counts/E denominator fail; no parameter/split changes
controls: native-vs-native pair comparison must give identical continuous/bucket errors and zero corrections/interaction
exact-reference continuous score comparison must give zero errors for all eligible non-tied pairs
